lines.text: There are fifty-six ways to cross a street grid.
lines.caption: There are fifty-six ways to cross a street grid.

lines.text: But block ONE corner, and more than half of them vanish!
lines.caption: But block ONE corner, and more than half of them vanish!

lines.text: Mia walks from A to B, going only right or up.
lines.caption: Mia walks from A to B, going only right or up.

lines.text: She can't step on the corner X. How many routes can she take?
lines.caption: She can't step on the corner X. How many routes can she take?

lines.text: Here's the trick. Write on every corner how many ways Mia can get there.
lines.caption: Here's the trick. Write on every corner how many ways Mia can get there.

lines.text: Each number is the one on its left, plus the one below.
lines.caption: Each number is the one on its left, plus the one below.

lines.text: X gets a zero. Now watch the numbers fill the grid!
lines.caption: X gets a zero. Now watch the numbers fill the grid!

lines.text: Now B. Seventeen plus nine makes twenty-six!
lines.caption: Now B. Seventeen plus nine makes twenty-six!

lines.text: That's Choice B. Counting every route would say fifty-six, which is wrong.
lines.caption: That's Choice B. Counting every route would say fifty-six, which is wrong.

lines.text: Why does adding work? The full lesson shows two ways, plus every trap.
lines.caption: Why does adding work? The full lesson shows two ways, plus every trap.
